fusions.name: Settling Leap
fusions.desc: Leaps you up to 6 tiles to a target, then deals 14 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Larval Drift
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of drifting larvae that deals 7 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 40% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Hard Landing
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 10 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Spat Over Stone
fusions.desc: You move 10% faster and have 6% physical resistance.
